title: Streaming vs Synchronous Latency Surfaceboard & Comparator
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a Surfaceboard-style dashboard that directly compares p50/p95/p99 latency across model + route combinations split by I/O mode (streaming vs synchronous). This ticket covers backend metric aggregation, trace hook enrichment, dashboard panel design, and playbook for investigating regressions. The goal is a single-pane comparator useful for SREs, platform PMs, and model owners to spot divergence between streaming and sync performance and correlate with trace-level root causes.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exposes p50/p95/p99 for streaming and synchronous requests independently for each model+route combination
Panels support time-window comparisons (last 1h/24h/7d) and cohort filtering by request shape (prompt length, response token count)
Every alertable SLO derived from the panels can link to representative traces (trace-id sample) and the trace flamegraph
Metric cardinality capped to prevent high cardinality explosion (prometheus-style labels capped; rollup buckets defined)
Design reviewed by UX and approved; Grafana/Looker panels merged and accessible to SREs and PMs
implementation_notes: Add 'io_mode' tag (streaming|sync) to latency histograms emitted by the serving runtime; annotate requests at the router when fronting multiple IO modes
Instrument trace hooks to attach sample KV cache hit ratio and batching size to span metadata for representative traces
Create aggregated histograms in the metrics pipeline (via pipeline job 'latency-fanout-aggregator') that compute p50/p95/p99 per (model, route, io_mode)
Implement adaptive rollups: for low-volume model-route combos roll up across models in the same family to preserve SLO visibility
Front-end: provide stacked/side-by-side view with delta column (streaming - sync) and significance highlighting when delta > 15%
Ensure downstream billing/usage tags are preserved in metrics to allow cost correlation

monitoring_playbook: If streaming p95 > sync p95 by > 20% for 1h: open incident bridge, tag candidates by model family and recent kernel selection changes
Collect representative traces: use 'take-sample' on combined histogram to link 5 slowest traces in the last 15 minutes
Check KV cache hit ratio span tag and batch size distribution; if KV hit ratio < 60% for affected cohort, escalate to runtime team
Rollback guidance: if streaming regressions follow a recent kernel or quantization change, add automatic routing to previous model variant for 10% of traffic as a mitigant
notes_for_ops: Be mindful of cardinality when enabling per-model per-route per-io_mode metrics; prefer rollups and sampling for <1qps combos
Use previously implemented trace retention policy and avoid full-span exports for sampled traces — export precomputed flamegraphs instead to reduce storage costs
